tasks.gr8-transport-and-trade-t4: Topic: Transport and trade. Cover reasons for trade, imports and exports, modes of transport, South African harbours, road versus rail, and urban commuter transport. Ask Grade 8 learners to connect transport choices to trade needs, interpret simple trade scenarios, and justify efficient movement of people and goods.
tasks.gr8-moving-goods-and-people-in-south-afr: Topic: Trade and transport in South Africa and people and transport in urban areas. Cover the advantages and disadvantages of road and rail transport, requirements for future transport networks, a case study of a South African harbour (reasons for location, main exports and imports, specialised ships such as container ships, tankers, passenger liners and bulk carriers, links with road, rail and pipeline), public and private commuter transport, transport issues (cost, congestion, pollution) and public transit strategies such as bus rapid transport, subsidised public transport, bus and cycle lanes, park and ride and car-free zones, with South African and international examples. Keep figures out of the lessons.
